updates.text: Turner held his anchor against Mosley and C.J. Wilson, lost one rep to Donald with late hands, then held the repeat. His combination with Brewster moved Donald and was split once. Stone did not invoke the conditional guard change.
updates.source: Source: [dated camp observations](career/2014/Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Training_Camp/training_report.md). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

short.text: Jacksonville drafted Trai Turner in the third round in 2014, and the rookie held the right guard job through camp and has started {{2014.regular.line_starts:words}} games. He plays with a powerful base, a strong anchor and short-area quickness, and in camp he held his anchor against C.J. Mosley and C.J. Wilson. His technique is still raw: hand placement, pass-set discipline and interior exchanges need coaching, and late hands cost him one rep against Aaron Donald in camp before he held the repeat.

transactions.text: Signed a four-year rookie contract with Jacksonville
